breakdown.description: Otto cycle is defined incorrectly (Otto has constant-volume heat addition, not constant-pressure).
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt incorrectly stated that an Otto cycle has constant-pressure heat addition. The agent resolved this by ignoring the incorrect definition and proceeding with a standard Otto cycle calculation, thereby implicitly correcting the cycle's definition to the correct constant-volume heat addition process associated with the Otto cycle.

breakdown.description: Efficiency formula is applied for a different cycle than described.
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt applied an Otto cycle efficiency formula to a cycle it incorrectly described as having constant-pressure heat addition (which would be a Diesel cycle). The agent resolved this by making the problem consistent: it assumed the user intended to analyze an Otto cycle and used the corresponding Otto cycle efficiency formula, thus aligning the cycle type with the calculation.
